item.title: Hartford Public Library opens café run by disability workforce nonprofit
item.description: Hartford Public Library has turned its downtown café into a workforce training ground, partnering with a local nonprofit that employs people with disabilities to run a new coffee shop that is open to the public.

item.description: Approved New Haven apartment conversion site sells for $2.9M to NY developer

item.title: Editor’s Take: CT should resist the wealth tax temptation
item.description: As other Democratic-led states pursue wealth taxes, Connecticut should resist the temptation — its finances depend too heavily on a small group of high earners who can afford to leave.

item.title: Texas-based dentist seeks OK to establish surgery center in Hartford area
item.description: A Texas-based dentist is seeking state approval to establish a dental surgery center in the Hartford area.

item.title: 🔒 Yale pledges $230M in voluntary payments to New Haven through 2033
item.description: The payments represent an increase from a 2021 agreement that provided more than $135 million to the city over a similar period.

item.title: CT Business Blend: March 9, 2026
item.description: Hartford Business Journal’s Greg Bordonaro and WTIC’s Brian Shactman explore the people, companies and trends shaping Connecticut’s business scene every Monday at 8:30 a.m. on WTIC 1080 AM.

item.title: 🔒 New London nonprofit completes phase two of mixed-income housing development
item.description: In total, the Bayonet Street apartments offer 64 residential units, with a mix of market‑rate, income‑restricted and supportive housing.

item.title: 🔒 CT gunmaker Ruger pushes back against European shareholder in board fight
item.description: Sturm, Ruger & Co. is pushing back against criticism from its largest shareholder, accusing the European gunmaker seeking seats on its board of attempting to gain influence over the company on terms that would disadvantage other investors.

item.title: 🔒 Developer seeks zoning change in Enfield to convert housing project to age-restricted community
item.description: A developer is seeking zoning changes in Enfield to convert a planned residential development into an age-restricted housing community.
